entries.04176e793e7268b6: This business provides engineers for software design, development, evaluation and analysis, and provides test planning, design and execution to find software defects. It is carried out by consolidated subsidiary Shain Tekku Inc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥361 million.
entries.05fad800d1a5b012: Companies that outsource software development and evaluation
entries.0b6fd9c9fd31ea33: Drawing on its foundational cyber security technology and research capabilities, this business sells products and provides services that protect computer systems from external threats. The company provides the products and services, and its consolidated subsidiary FFRI Security Works Inc. provides the security services. The equity-method affiliate N.F. Laboratories Inc. provides security education and training. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,987 million.
entries.6f121b90896caf10: Sales of security products such as FFRI yarai. Using fully heuristic detection technology that does not depend on pattern files, the company sells, under subscription or perpetual licenses, products that defend against known and unknown malware and attacks targeting vulnerabilities. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,756 million.
entries.703ef5e901e893d5: A company that conducts research and development in cyber security and provides products against targeted attacks and services related to security and defense.
entries.cfa2448f37e2cca6: Provision of security services other than national security services. The company conducts vulnerability testing, security education and training for human resource development, consulting, provision of security information, and commissioned development. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥654 million.
entries.f59317ca1526d8a7: Provision of security services related to national security. The company conducts government research and development projects, security research, investigation and analysis, and human resource education and training. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,576 million.
